subject: MedLytics pilot - request for short runway while PO clears
messages:
From: June Li <june.li@medlytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medlytics.com, Tomas Rivera <tomas@medlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access - short runway while PO clears

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the MedLytics team made good progress with the ingestion connector and models. Finance is processing our PO but it’s stalled in the VP review queue and we risk the pilot environment being throttled tomorrow.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short runway (top-up credits or a temporary extension) so we can keep the live tests running through the end of next week? We expect PO approval by May 26 but don’t have a firm PO number yet. If helpful, I attached the PO draft and a short usage summary.

High level:
- Pilot name: ClinicalSummarize Proof-of-Concept
- Current spend/runway: ~60% consumed (see attached)
- Expected PO approver: Marcus Lin, VP Finance (if you need to reach out)

Appreciate any flexibility — we’re on the critical path for the clinical integration demo.

Thanks,
June Li
Program Manager, MedLytics
june.li@medlytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MedLytics_PO_draft_8791.pdf (application/pdf), pilot_usage_report_MedLytics_May12-18.csv (text/csv)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: June Li <june.li@medlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access - short runway while PO clears

Hi June — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO and usage report.

We can absolutely help avoid an interruption. Tentatively we can apply a 3-day pilot top-up (equivalent of $2,500 or 75k token units) while finance clears the PO. To do 7 days would require a short internal signoff from revenue ops given the size of the extension; Ben and I can coordinate that if you expect approval by May 26.

Quick asks to process immediately:
- Can you share the expected PO number (even a draft number) or confirm the exact approval date?
- Will Marcus Lin be the signatory? If you can share the approver email, we can loop in our contracts team if needed.

Ben (cc) — can you confirm we can stretch to 7 days if MedLytics confirms PO clearance by 2027-05-26? Camila — happy to set a checkpoint call for Friday to cover the integration items and demonstrate the latest logs.

Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access - short runway while PO clears

Sofia —

If MedLytics can commit to an official PO issuance by 2027-05-26 (and copy our contracts@redwood.ai thread when it goes to Marcus), I’m comfortable approving a 7-day runway extension as a one-time concession. We should capture the commitment in email and note that this is a temporary grace — no SLA changes.

Camila, please line up a brief technical checkpoint (30 minutes) on Friday so they can show the last-mile integration items; that’ll reduce follow-ups and lower overall token consumption risk.

I’ll also flag revenue ops to expect a PO and to expedite billing sequencing when it arrives.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access - short runway while PO clears

Thanks Sofia and Ben — really appreciate the quick responses.

I can confirm the PO should route to Marcus Lin for sign-off; procurement has indicated the target approval date as 2027-05-26 and expects to issue PO # (formal) that day. I’ve attached the draft PO for reference and included a short usage export.

If you’re willing to approve the 7-day runway contingent on our PO issuance on 5/26, we’re happy to accept that and I’ll make sure Marcus is copied on the final when it goes live.

Link to shared draft: https://drive.redwood.example/medlytics/PO_draft_8791

Best,
June

Attachments: MedLytics_PO_draft_8791.pdf (application/pdf), pilot_usage_report_MedLytics_May12-18.csv (text/csv)

June — confirmed. We will apply a 7-day runway extension to the account effective immediately, contingent on MedLytics issuing the formal PO by 2027-05-26 and copying contracts@redwood.ai. This extension is a one-time, goodwill concession to preserve pilot momentum; standard billing terms apply once the PO is received.

Next steps:
- June: please send the formal PO number and Marcus Lin’s approver email when it’s issued.
- Camila: can you schedule a 30-minute checkpoint Friday 5/21 at 11:00am PT (invite sent).
- Ben: I’ll follow up with revenue ops to flag the incoming PO DL-8791.

Thanks everyone — we’ll monitor usage and reopen if any unexpected spikes occur.

Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
